candidates.change_summary: Move the external call to msg.sender.call before zeroing the caller's credit (introduces reentrancy vulnerability / changes post-withdraw state if reentered).
Set credit to zero before decreasing balance (balance can become incorrect / negative underflow prevented by Solidity 0.8 but behavior differs).
Perform the external call with zero value (prevents Ether transfer while keeping state changes), altering observable balance behavior.
Replace require(callResult) with an unconditional ignore of call failure (removes revert on failed send, changing post-call state observable).
After zeroing the caller's credit, restore it (sets credit back and prevents withdrawal observable effect).
